preconditions.description: The length of the string s must be between 3 and 5000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must consist only of small English letters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the probability of Vasya winning, formatted as a string.
The absolute or relative error of the output probability must not exceed 10^-6.
